# QE Test Strategy Skill

Define a balanced test pyramid and quality gates for each service. Include unit, component, API/service integration, provider contract, workflow/E2E, visual regression, accessibility, performance/load, security, resilience/recovery and migration tests as relevant. Specify test ownership, CI trigger, environment, test data, mocks/fakes policy, flake policy, coverage intent and exit criteria. Prefer behavior and risk coverage over arbitrary line coverage targets.
